ambiguities: PRB-004: it is not stated whether focus stays on the place title after Board.Loading turns into Board.Ready, or whether the retry button's focus is kept at all (FOC-1 with a pointer click).
PRB-013: WEB-6 says the focus stop comes after "Select all" of its column, but does not say outright that Tab from the focus stop goes to the next column's "Select all".
PRB-023: whether a pointer exactly at the middle of a card counts as "above" for carry-to, and whether the layout shift of the carried card changes where SL-113 is.
PRB-049/050: "history depth" after Back is read as the total entries (Back removes none), as in SCN-NAV-1.
Error notices have the extra action "Dismiss", but the notice text of some rules lists only the named action.
